## The Function

The bear mascot belongs to the following school! Expand to see the full code!

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true

college <- function(mascot) {
  if (tolower(mascot) == "bear") {
    return("UC Berkeley")
  } else if (tolower(mascot) == "tree") {
    return("Stanford")
  } else {
    return("Unknown School")
  }
}

college("Bear")
```
